sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The objective of this scheme is to end the caste system in the state and encourage inter-caste marriages by providing financial assistance to couples. Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries will receive a one-time grant of ₹1,00,000/-. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Social welfare & Empowerment; Sector: Marriage

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Antarjatiye Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana&quot; is a sub-scheme of the &quot;Mukhyamantri Vivah Protsahan Anudan Yojana&quot;, initiated by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. The objective of this scheme is to end the caste system in the state and encourage inter-caste marriages by providing financial assistance to couples. This scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - Under this scheme, eligible beneficiaries will receive a one-time grant of ₹1,00,000/-. **Note:** The grant will be provided to the bride.

**Application Process:** - To avail of the benefits of this scheme, individuals who meet the eligibility criteria should submit their applications in the prescribed form to the Assistant Director, District Social Security Office. **Note:** After approval and verification, the details of the beneficiaries will be transmitted on the e-Suvidha portal for payment by the Assistant Director, District Social Security Office. > **Grievance Redressal &amp; Escalation Matrix:** - The complaint can be lodged in the Block Development Officer, Sub-divisional Office, Assistant Director, District Social Security Cell/District Child Protection Unit, Director, Social Security Office and the office of Additional Chief Secretary/Principal Secretary/Secretary, Social Welfare Department. The office of Public Grievance Redressal Officer is functioning at the sub-divisional level and the office of District Public Grievance Redressal Officer is functioning at the district level.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Social Welfare Department, Government Of Bihar; Nodal Department: Social Welfare Department
**Tags:** Antarjatiye, Vivah, Inter-caste Marriage, Financial Assistance
